flow_nodes.description: useSkill(review) mounts the imported SkillReference in the current render.
The runtime lists name and description in Available Skills.
The model may call activate_skill at runtime; this lab does not observe a live call.
CHECKLIST.txt is packaged with the review skill and read lazily.

boundary_notes: A skill teaches behavior and does not grant shell or workspace file access. File and command tools come from a sandbox.
human_completion_criteria: A reviewer can follow the listed paths and see import, mount, activation mechanism, supporting file, and sandbox boundary.
